constraints: Use only standard C99 with stdint.h types (uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t, uint64_t)
No dynamic memory allocation or malloc/free
All loops must have compile-time determinable bounds
Must be synthesizable by PandA-Bambu HLS tool
Token arrays must be passed as fixed-size arrays or pointers with known bounds
No use of Xilinx-specific types like ap_uint or ap_int
Maximum function complexity under 200 lines of code
The comparison loop must iterate exactly 16 times
description: Implement a hardware-synthesizable C function that compares a 16-byte input token against a stored 16-byte reference token. The function must return a single-bit match result (1 for exact match, 0 for any mismatch). The implementation must be suitable for synthesis with PandA-Bambu HLS tools and must process all input bytes to produce the result.

functional_requirements.requirement: The function must compare all 16 bytes of input_token against reference_token
Return 1 if and only if all 16 bytes match exactly
Return 0 if any byte position contains different values
The function must process the full 16-byte length for all inputs
Use only standard C99 types from stdint.h (uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t, uint64_t)

interface:
uint8_t compare_token(const uint8_t input_token[16], const uint8_t reference_token[16]);

Parameters:
- input_token: pointer to 16-byte array containing the token to verify
- reference_token: pointer to 16-byte array containing the expected token value

Return value:
- 1 if all 16 bytes match exactly
- 0 if any byte differs
